summary: Southern Company Gas filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing that the Illinois Commerce Commission approved a Stipulation and Settlement among its Nicor Gas subsidiary, Commission Staff, the Illinois Attorney General, and other intervenors. The settlement resolves Nicor Gas's January 9, 2026 general base rate case, raising annual base rate revenues by approximately $82 million effective November 16, 2026, with a 9.48% return on equity and 50.00% equity ratio. Nicor Gas will move to dismiss its appeal of the prior 2025 rate case once the order is final. This is a routine regulatory rate order, not a special situation.
